title: Transfer Fcn (with initial outputs)
text: Specify the initial output for the transfer function, {State Name (e.g., ''''position'''')} sets Option to assign unique names to states; {Numerator coefficients} sets the vector or matrix of numerator coefficients, {Denominator coefficients} sets the row vector of denominator coefficients, {Parameter tunability} sets the tunable representation of block parameters and {Absolute tolerance}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Numerator coefficients
params.values: Vector or matrix of numerator coefficients [1] (default) | vector | matrix

params.name: Denominator coefficients
params.values: Row vector of denominator coefficients [1 1] (default) | vector

params.name: Parameter tunability
params.values: Tunable representation of block parameters in code Auto (default) | Optimized | Unconstrained

params.name: Absolute tolerance
params.values: Absolute tolerance for computing block states auto (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: State Name (e.g., ''''position'''')
params.values: Option to assign unique names to states '''''''' (default) | character vector | cell array of character vectors | MATLAB® variable | ...
